newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's June coffee crop at 1.07 million bags.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's June coffee crop at 1.07 million bags.

text.p: Colombia's June coffee crop totaled 1.07 million 60-kg bags compared to 858,000 bags in the same month last year, sources at the National Coffee Growers Federation said Friday.
For the first six months of this year, the harvest was running at 4.7 million bags compared to 5.3 million bags in the first six months of 1996, according to federation figures.
The latest figures mean that the harvest for the 1996/97 coffee year, which runs from October through September and has now completed three full quarters, is running at 8.3 million 60-kg bags.
The federation's latest estimate for total production for the 1996/97 coffee year is "about" 10 million bags, down from the 10.4 million bags forecast earlier in the year.

Production for the final quarter, July-September, is seen at 1.5 million bags, according to the federation. If last quarter predictions are fulfilled the final harvest will total 9.8 million bags, slightly below the federation's worst scenario forecast.
